checks: The lift of the two endpoint bodies has only bases -1,0,1, and equal endpoint interpolation weights at zero give exactly M. The raw measure is the sum of three ordinary areas, with total a(r+2) and r>=1 by planar Brunn–Minkowski.

A containing ambient cap dominates its parallel cap through the mark. With a nonzero continuous normal the actual middle trace is a centroid cap and the endpoint shifts are opposite. The own payment is at least 4|M|/9, the width payment is a/9, and the residual payment is a max(0,F(r)). For r>=1 the positive part on 2 sqrt(5r/9)-1 is unnecessary and expanding its square gives the displayed F.

The integer-normal branch captures all of M and one endpoint. The paired term in the bound is at most a, since the residual lower formula is at most one in units of a, so this branch gives at least G(r) too.

F strictly decreases on [1,infinity). Squaring the two positive sides of F=1/9 gives 400r^2-680r+1=0 with only r_*=(17+12 sqrt(2))/20 in the domain. Below r_* the derivative numerator of G is 6 sqrt(5)(2-r)/sqrt(r)-32<0; above it the rational branch is strictly increasing.

Exact substitution at r_* gives 4(22+12 sqrt(2))/(9(57+12 sqrt(2))). Its difference from 2/9 has numerator 2(12 sqrt(2)-13)>0, certified by 288>169. The minimum is a guaranteed bound and does not assert sharpness of actual depth.
